title: Measured magnetic inclination and total field: 186 observatories (annual means) and 2,147 survey stations, with IGRF-14

radius_enters_via.how: magnetic latitude from the IGRF pole, a model fitted on the globe; the measured I and F themselves carry no radius

verdict_rule: A flat residual box centred on zero and as narrow as the globe's, with the same median north and south of the magnetic equator; or a field-strength box narrower than every globe box.
license_note: BGS World Data Centre for Geomagnetism (Edinburgh): data free for scientific use with acknowledgement of the WDC and the observatory operators / survey institutes; IGRF-14 (IAGA) public.

sources.cite: BGS World Data Centre for Geomagnetism (Edinburgh), Worldwide Observatory Annual Means; values supplied by the observatory operators
BGS World Data Centre for Geomagnetism (Edinburgh), Global Survey Data (repeat stations and one-off stations), via the WDC API; values supplied by national survey institutes
IAGA, International Geomagnetic Reference Field, 14th generation (IGRF-14) coefficients

units.lat, lon: degrees, geodetic, N and E positive (lon -180..180 in the outputs)
units.q: WDC mean code (1 all days, 2 quiet days, 4 absolute obs only) or R / O / M / A / C

inputs.origin: Our list of the sources and their adapters.
BGS WDC Worldwide Observatory Annual Means form (the list of observatories), as fetched on 2026-10-14.
BGS WDC annual-means page of each observatory (fog fetch mag-obs).
inputs.caveats: Values are supplied by the observatory operators; a few years are flagged provisional on the pages.

inputs.origin: BGS WDC API, global geomagnetic survey (repeat and one-off stations).

notes: Edit sources.json only (adapters: wdc-annual-means, wdc-survey, csv), then fog fetch mag-obs, fog lock mag-obs, fog build mag-obs, node scripts/fit_mag_obs.mjs. raw/annual_means.html is the WDC form (the list of observatories) as fetched on 2026-10-14; it reproduces the 2026-09-28 build exactly (KLI listed but not fetched, HON fetched but no longer listed).
public_raw_why: The BGS World Data Centre allows scientific use with acknowledgement but does not say that its pages and answers may be republished; only the hash and the source are given.
